activity_summary: After the Shrew you stood a few minutes in the parlour with Richard and Kemp. You did not name the part. Set at Maw was the Rose, and you did not go. Tomorrow is the ghost.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ended the play unnamed, and did not cross the river.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Stopped the talk of the afternoon and sent you home.

facets.activity: Stood with Richard and Kemp after the Shrew

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Set at Maw was the Rose

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Thou stood where the book put thee;
